name: research-os-copilot
description: Material-first browser copilot bridge for Codex Research OS.

interface.shortDescription: Use a browser cockpit to start Research OS from material uploads.
interface.longDescription: Research OS Copilot provides a material-first browser cockpit, a local MCP bridge, and a confirmation queue so Codex can initialize and continue human-in-loop research projects from uploaded materials without exposing private data.
